ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Bodged
ModMetaData.author: Zapdude
ModMetaData.description: Important: This mod must be placed right below Core/Expansions and above MPCompatability to work correctly. Requires RimWorld >= 1.6.4491\n This is a fork of Multiplayer including upstream PRs targeting desyncs and connection issues, alongside fixes written by me to fix errors I've personally encountered. It integrates PRs 996, 998, 1004, 1009, 1010, 1011 onto dev. Full list of changes over Multiplayer 0.11.5 can be found in About/changelog.md. I will not link to MP's Discord/FAQ because any reports due to using this fork shouldn't go to them. Should be obvious but this fork wouldn't exist without years of hard work from 60+ contributors. It is temporary and for personal use.
